Facts: Herman Avery Gundy was convicted of committing sexual assault in Maryland while on supervised release for a prior federal offense. He was convicted and sentenced to time served, along with five years of supervised release. The 2nd Circuit affirmed this judgment on appeal. Posture: Writ of certiorari
